operators.name: equal_forward
semantics: Computes element-wise equality between x and y (torch.eq) on CUDA tensors.
Broadcasting is not required because x and y have identical shapes in the reference.
Returns bool tensor of same shape as x, with True where x == y else False.

operators.name: argsort_lastdim_forward
semantics: Computes stable argsort along the last dimension (torch.argsort(x, dim=-1)).
For each vector along dim=-1, returns indices of sorted values in ascending order.
Stability: equal values preserve their original relative order (as in PyTorch's stable sort).
Output dtype is int64, same shape as x.
Element-wise equality between x and y, producing a bool tensor of same shape.
No broadcasting needed since shapes match.
Equivalent to calling custom equal_forward(x, y) after moving inputs to CUDA.
Stable argsort along last dimension, producing an int64 tensor of same shape.
Performs sorting of each row (last axis) independently.
Equivalent to calling custom argsort_lastdim_forward(x) after moving input to CUDA.
Returns a tuple containing the equality boolean tensor and the argsort int64 tensor.
Container type must be tuple to match reference.
